rounds.text: Muthoot Capital Services Ltd is trading at a significant discount to its asset base, with a price-to-book ratio of 0.53x against a book value of ₹ 408 on a share price of ₹ 215 [E2], and trades favorably compared to its sector benchmark P/B of 1.52x [E7]. This valuation disconnect is further highlighted by an EV/EBITDA of 8.82x, which sits well below the sector benchmark of 21.55x [E11], alongside a modest P/E of 14.1 [E1] that is discounted relative to the sector benchmark P/E of 25.26x [E6]. Operational momentum is showing sharp acceleration, evidenced by a trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth of 22% [E17] and an extraordinary net profit surge of 274% year-over-year [E59]. Furthermore, insiders are showing confidence through commitment as promoter shareholding has increased from 62.62% in Sep 2023 to 63.33% as of Jun 2026 [E35], all supported by a robust Financial Services sector tailwind score of 0.83 [E70]. conceded: [E30], [E39], [E54].

Despite a sector tailwind score of +0.83 [E70], Muthoot Capital Services Ltd carries severe valuation and fundamental risks that are unsupported by the evidence. A discounted cash flow model values the intrinsic price at just Rs 161 per share against a market price of Rs 215, leaving a negative margin of safety of -33.2% [E39, E40]. Compounded profit growth over 5 years is -25% and over 3 years is -46%, demonstrating deep historical earnings erosion [E19, E20]. Furthermore, operating cash flow collapsed to Rs -375 Cr in March 2026, resulting in a dire cash conversion of -34.09x and free cash flow of Rs -381 Cr [E30, E31, E32]. Institutional money flow is negative with foreign institutions reducing their stake [E36, E38], and the rules-based screen scores the stock a low confidence 43 out of 100 pointing to a sell [E58]. Conceded: the company trades at a low price-to-book of 0.53x and has recently shown a significant year-over-year net profit increase [E2, E59].
